description: Turn one or more finished video scripts into a single one-tap link that opens the user's Daily Studio app with the script(s) loaded into the teleprompter and the right platform safe-zones selected, ready to record. For one script use `text`; for a batch the user will record back-to-back (a day's 3-4 videos, or a whole content plan — up to 100), use `scripts` — they land as an in-app shoot queue in order, and ONE link carries them all. Call this only once the scripts are final. Returns a link the user taps on their iPhone; on a desktop it opens a page with a QR code to scan.

platform.description: Where the video will be published. Selects that platform's safe-zone overlay so on-screen UI never covers the creator. Omit to leave the user's choice alone. With `scripts`, applies to items that don't set their own.

scripts.description: A batch of scripts (in recording order) delivered as a single link — up to 100 of them, 400000 characters of script in total. The app queues them; after each recording it offers the next. Provide either this or `text`, not both.

text.description: The finished talking-head script: one hook, one idea and a short closing, plain UTF-8.

title.description: Short label shown in the app's shoot queue, e.g. 'Video 2: myth-busting'.

text.description: A finished talking-head script to speak directly to camera, plain UTF-8. Newlines allowed. Provide either this or `scripts`, not both.

title.description: Optional short label for `text`, e.g. 'Cold plunge hook'.

wpm.description: Optional scroll speed in words per minute. Sets the app's teleprompter speed. Omit to leave the user's setting alone. With `scripts`, applies to items that don't set their own.

name: send_script_to_teleprompter
title: Send script to teleprompter
